visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Multiplying Before Dividing Overflows
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The LCM of 100000 and 99999 is 9999900000, but the program prints 1409965408.

solution.explanation: a * b is calculated with ints first, and 100000 * 99999 does not fit in 32 bits, so it wraps around before the division happens. Dividing by the gcd first (and widening to long) keeps the intermediate result small.
